name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Both numeric suffixes are meaningful domain IDs that must be preserved: '05' = dispatch idx 0x05 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (verified: table slot at 0x51BA5 holds 0x34D68; idx = (0x51BA5-0x51B91)/4 = 5), 'ch13' = chapter 13 = Battle of Hasmir (verified via assets/chapters/chapter_13.md). 'thunk' accurately reflects the original 7-byte adapter stub (PUSH 0x28; JMP 0x34BE7) that tail-jumps into the shared body. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Chapter-event dispatch handler idx 0x05 (chapter 13 / Battle of Hasmir turn-event beat): reload portrait set 1 and show chapter-text dialog page 1.
logic_summary: In the original binary a 7-byte adapter stub: PUSH 0x28; JMP 0x34BE7. The pushed 0x28 is the __CHK stack-probe frame size that the shared body fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1 @ 0x34BE7 consumes via its compiler-injected CALL __CHK prologue; the tail-JMP transfers into that shared body so the thunk's whole effect is the shared body's effect (fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) then fd2_display_dialog_scene(text, page=1, fixed dialog geometry)). The compiler-injected __CHK probe is omitted at Layer-2, so src emits this as a direct call to the helper fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1(). Straight-line, no branch, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used; the dispatch arg is never read.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatch argument supplied by the uniform 1-arg cdecl per-event handler table at 0x51B91; never read by this handler's body.
params.reason: Descriptive of the table-dispatch contract, consistent with every other handler in chevt1.c, and carries no address residue. Body marks it unused via (void)event_arg.

notes: Verified: disassembly @ 0x34D68 = PUSH 0x28 (68 28000000); JMP rel32 e9 75feffff -> 0x34BE7. Handler-table slot @ 0x51BA5 = 0x34D68 (684D0300 LE), confirming dispatch idx 0x05. JMP target 0x34BE7 = fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1 whose entry begins CALL __CHK (0x36CD7), consuming the caller-pushed 0x28 frame size (Class-3 shared-body pattern). Chapter 13 = Battle of Hasmir confirmed via fd2-knowledge chapter 13. src comment block (chevt1.c lines 1446-1469) already accurate/precise/ASCII and consistent with Ghidra plate; no edit to src, no plate change. is_thunk metadata was false but function is in fact an adapter thunk in the original binary -- this is correctly captured by the existing name/comment and is not a logic concern (the src emits the equivalent direct call).
